'''Bloodveld''' can be found in the [[God Wars Dungeon]]. They can be fought for killcount for the [[Zamorak]] faction.

Equipping an [[God Wars Dungeon/God Protection|item aligned to Zamorak]], a piece of [[ancient equipment]] or the [[Shard of Zaros]] makes them non-aggressive.

==Trivia==
* The examine text of bloodveld is similar to other slayer monsters. The bloodveld is "the tongue of evil", the [[dust devil]] is "the vacuumed face of evil", the [[basilisk]] is "the eyes of evil" and the [[rockslug]] "the slime of evil."
* The bloodveld seems to attack twice in a row but it only attacks once, as seen on the hitsplats.
* Vampyres keep bloodveld as pets, in a similar fashion to the way in which humans keep dogs. [[Harold]], who belongs to [[Vanstrom Klause]] is one example, as are [[Grigan Kaninus]]' [[bloodveld youngling]]s.
* In the {{Pfth|12}}, their tongues are likened to that of KISS bassist {{WP|Gene_Simmons|Gene Simmons}}, a rock star who himself has an unusually long tongue.
* On [[16 January]] 2017, their attack style and weakness were changed from magic and thrown weapons to melee and fire spells, respectively.
* As of [[1 February]] [[2018]], the highest kill count for this monster was 80,366 kills.{{CiteReddit|author=Mod Shauny|url=https://www.reddit.com/r/runescape/comments/7uqsoh/top_10_killers_per_slayer_creature/|title=Top 10 killers per Slayer Creature|quote=Here are the top 10 kills for each Slayer creature in RuneScape, be aware that we've not listed display names for privacy purposes however if you wish to brag about one number being yours then we won't stop you!|date=2 February 2018|archiveurl=http://archive.is/Qgydj|archivedate=28 February 2020|notes=|name=}}
** This had not increased by [[6 May]] 2018.{{CiteReddit|author=Mod Shauny|url=https://www.reddit.com/r/runescape/comments/8hjcvq/top_slayer_killers_6th_may_2018/|title=Top Slayer Killers - 6th May 2018|quote=Here are the top 10 kills for each Slayer creature in RuneScape, be aware that we've not listed display names for privacy purposes however if you wish to brag about one number being yours then we won't stop you!|date=6 May 2018|archiveurl=http://archive.is/Fxc11|archivedate=28 February 2020|notes=|name=}}
